new_assertions.title: route-A transporter is an odd involution
new_assertions.body: The complete mapping 197500 fixes slots 0,1,4 and swaps slots 2 and 3; applying it twice returns every represented slot to itself, and its inversion parity is 1.

new_assertions.title: route-B transporter is an odd involution
new_assertions.body: The complete mapping 197501 fixes slots 2,3,4 and swaps slots 0 and 1; applying it twice returns every represented slot to itself, and its inversion parity is 1.

new_assertions.title: relative transporter is even
new_assertions.body: The definitionally composed transporter 197502 = 197501 after 197500 maps slots as [1,0,3,2,4], has exactly two inversions, and therefore has represented parity bit 0.

new_assertions.title: route phase difference is odd while relative transporter parity is even
new_assertions.body: The two shortest route phases differ by XOR 1, while the exact relative transporter 197502 has parity bit 0.

new_assertions.title: relative transporter parity cannot explain the shortest phase difference
new_assertions.body: On the shortest 5x4 two-route witness, even relative transporter parity coexists with an odd route-phase difference; relative transporter parity alone therefore cannot equal or determine the represented phase difference on this pair.

new_assertions.title: oriented action histories share their second action and differ at the first
new_assertions.body: The two represented source-frame action sequences are (1,2) and (0,2): their second action slot is the same represented slot 2 and their first action slots differ.

support_refinements.witness: The two complete represented transporter maps independently reduce to one inversion each, hence equal parity bit 1.
support_refinements.note: This replaces reliance on an opaque sign observation with primitive map/order/inversion/XOR support.

add_fixed: the exact relative transporter of the shortest route pair is even while the represented route-phase difference is odd
remove_alternatives: ordinary parity of the exact relative transporter is sufficient to explain the shortest route-phase difference
retain_open: full non-parity transporter/orientation structure matters on some obstruction components
an intrinsic endpoint/residual relation subsumes the needed transition distinction
a relabeling-invariant state coordinate makes transporter history unnecessary

rejected_candidates.body: Because the relative transporter is even, full transporter structure is irrelevant.
rejected_candidates.reason: Parity loses information; the full relative map remains nontrivial and the current evidence only falsifies its parity projection.

rejected_candidates.body: The differing first action alone causes the phase difference.
rejected_candidates.reason: The exact sequences differ at the first action, but co-occurrence does not prove causal sufficiency.
